items.title: Generative AI Intern
bullets: Built an AI trade selection system (XGBoost) turning a -Rs. 225k loss into +Rs. 93k profit at 74% win rate.
Designed and deployed 6 parallel strategy engines processing 500+ NSE stocks every 5 minutes.
Implemented 3-way time-split walk-forward validation across 1.2 years of data, holding edge across all regimes.
Deployed via Docker and Docker Compose on GCP with PostgreSQL, a live dashboard, and Telegram trade alerts.
